critical_intel.detail: Region Uppsala LK ordf + NT-rådet Mellansverige. Strategisk access node.
Region Jönköping LK ordf + NT-rådet Sydöstra. Plus NT-rådet CHAIR Mårten Lindström hemma i Jönköping.

Pia Näsvall moved from Norrbotten to Västerbotten on 1 October 2025 (announced June 2025). Continues as NSG Läkemedel ordförande. Norrbotten HSD seat held tf. by Maria Joelsson pending permanent appointment.
Anders Bergström (Norrbotten apotekare) = NT-rådet Vice Chair.
VGR Helén Eliasson (S), Örebro Jenny Steen (S), Halland Mikaela Waltersson (M), Västernorrland Åsa Bellander + Roger Westerlund

Skåne RD Myrebris (2025-12), Östergötland HSD Landergren (2025-06), Blekinge HSD Nilsson (2025-07), VGR HSD Claesson (2025-10), Norrbotten Tf. Thörnqvist (2026-01), Örebro HSD vacant post-Claesson, Västernorrland Nylund (2024-10)
Uppsala: Sjukhusstyrelsen+Vårdstyrelsen; Halland: lokala HSN per kommun + HSU; Gotland: kombinerad kommun+region

Mårten Lindström currently tf. ordförande (since predecessor Åsa Derolf departure). Margareta Holmström (associate professor Linköping U; senior physician coagulation Karolinska) takes over as ordinary Chair from 2026-07-01.
Talla Alkurdi (S) is current HSN ordförande / Sjukvårdsregionråd, NOT Anna Starbrink. Confirmed both fact-check reports 2026-04-25.
Anna Alm Andersson (permanent RD, replaced Thörnqvist tf.); Maria Joelsson (tf. HSD, replaced Pia Näsvall who moved to Västerbotten).
Katarina Nyberg-Finn (hyphenated) is HSN ordf JÄMTLAND H. ONLY. Jönköping HSN (Nämnd för folkhälsa och sjukvård) is chaired by Thomas Gustafsson (S).
Magdalena Bosson installed Jan 2026 after Ingeborg Eriksson resignation; departure linked to Oskarshamn ER closure controversy + JO complaint.
Lars Almroth current; Jonas Cederberg becomes tf. HSD from 2026-05-04 (officially announced).
First Swedish region to corporatize public primary care via wholly-owned aktiebolag; RD Göran Angergård serves dual role as acting CEO.
Bo Sundqvist is canonical LK ordförande Västerbotten (per samverkanlakemedel.se). Earlier deck error listed Pia Näsvall in this slot — Näsvall is HSD, not LK ordf.
Region Uppsala (Sjukhusstyrelsen + Vårdstyrelsen split), Halland (local municipal HSNs), Sörmland (RS acts as HSN) do not have a single HSN ordförande — represent as STRUCTURAL in mapping.
